method: Rubric for a reviewer reading a transcript of the skill at work; no model run is recorded here.

cases.prompt: 농장 마을을 three.js로 도트 느낌 3D 디오라마로 만들어줘.
must: render into a low-res target and enlarge by an integer factor with image-rendering: pixelated
outline from depth with a threshold that scales with the texel size
snap the camera target to the texel grid on the right and up axes only
measure draw calls before and after baking and instancing
report phone GPU performance as NOT_RUN unless a phone was used

cases.prompt: 카메라가 따라갈 때 건물 픽셀이 한 칸씩 지글거려.
must: name the missing texel snap as the cause
keep the low-res height instead of raising the resolution to hide it
stay read-only until the user asks for the fix
read renderer.info calls with autoReset off before changing anything
mark every node that changes after build as live before baking
skip rendering while the canvas is off screen and keep the simulation running
compare screenshots before and after so nothing that moved stands still

cases.prompt: 새벽 항구 마을을 도트 3D 디오라마로 만들어줘. 분위기는 알아서 잡아줘.
must: write the direction sheet before scene code, every row a number, a named colour or a rule, and label the derived look a default
take sizes, colours and what stands where from the sheet, with a reason for any value shared with the worked example
block out ground, landmark, stage and supporting masses and shoot all four rotations before adding detail
fill landmark, structures, props and life in that order and give each prop a user
report LOOK and FUNCTION as separate verdicts, each with its evidence

cases.prompt: 풋살 5인제 경기를 떠 있는 작은 학교 운동장 섬 도트 3D 디오라마로, 한 번에 만들어줘. 코트 표면 4종, 낮·황혼·밤, 폰 폭까지.
must: write the direction sheet first, including a value plan, one mood row, a hero rotation and quiet zones
build the palette from hue-shifted ramps with the recipe instead of copying the worked example's PALETTE or lighting rows
keep every team kit and court surface on its own palette entry and apart in grayscale
run the critique passes on the blockout shots and again on the dressed scene, applying each fix
draw wire, rails and ropes two pixels or more in the mode they are read in
report LOOK and FUNCTION separately, and NOT_RUN for phone GPU performance

cases.prompt: 디오라마가 휑하고 밋밋해 보여. 뭐가 문제야?
must: read the direction sheet back from the code and screenshots instead of restyling
name the rows with no value and the tier that is missing or thin
stay read-only until the user asks for the fix
